attempts.text:
BIJAYANI MOHANTY

Credit Consultant/Manager | Risk Analyst

& 7978903735 @monbiju97@gmail.com @linkedin.com 9 Gurgaon

SUMMARY

lam a Credit Consultant/Manager with more than 3 years of
experience in evaluating creditworthiness, advising clients on credit
improvement strategies, and optimizing financial health for individuals
and businesses.

EXPERIENCE

Manager Credit

U GRO Capital # 03/2023 - Present 9 Gurgaon, India

e Developed and implemented credit policies and procedures to
assess customer creditworthiness, reducing default risk and
aligning with company risk appetite by 30%

e Managed the full credit lifecycle, including credit checks,
approvals, collections, and account reconciliation, overseeing a
portfolio worth 5 million.

e Monitored accounts receivable and ensured timely collection of
payments, resulting in improved Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) by
10% over 3 months.

e Conducted financial analysis and credit reviews for new and
existing clients, setting appropriate credit limits and terms.

e Collaborated with sales, finance, and legal teams to support
contract negotiations while protecting the company financial
interests.

e Trained and supervised a team of 8 credit analysts/assistants,
fostering a high-performing and compliant credit control
department.

e Reduced credit default risk by 50% through implementation of
enhanced risk assessment tools and regular account monitoring.

e Accelerated credit approval turnaround time by 60% faster by
streamlining the review process and automating reporting tools.

e Supported the growth of the customer base by providing sound
credit recommendations for over 5 Cr in approval in 1 month.

Assistant Credit Manager

CapitalNow @ 04/2022 - 08/2022 9 Hyderabad, India

e Assessed credit risk and analysed financial statements.

e Conducted financial review of customer lines of credit by
assessing company financials and initiating credit application
reviews. Performed creditreviews on corporations to assess
financial conditions

Credit Analyst

Hero Fin m 04/2021-10/2021 9 New Delhi, India

e Improved understanding of financial statements, which helped in
assessing risk. Controlled credit exposure by providing financial.

e Order management support to minimize risk and obtain timely
payment.

e Completed paperwork, recognizing discrepancies and promptly
addressing for resolution.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Reduced bad debt write-offs by 30%
year-over-year through tighter credit
assessments and proactive risk
management.

v

7 Improved cash flow by accelerating
collections cycle, achieving increase
in on-time payment.

2 Successfully negotiated payment
terms with key clients, securing
favorable outcomes while
maintaining strong business
relationships.

2 Process Improvement Streamlined
reporting processes, resulting in a
50% reduction in preparation time
and enhanced accuracy.

SKILLS

Credit Risk Assessment, Credit Policy
Development, Credit Limit Setting,
Customer Credit Evaluation, Collections
Management, Control Bad Debt
Reduction, Loan & Credit Approvals,

LANGUAGES

English

EDUCATION

Masters in Economics

Birla Global University

# 07/2019 - 07/2021
9 Bhubaneshwar, India
